authority.conformant_adapter: GKOS-Engine-Lite verifies normalized envelopes and delegates; it never parses YAML or TOML

profile.line_count_semantics: split on LF or CRLF; one terminal line terminator closes the preceding logical line and does not add a synthetic empty line; every earlier blank or comment line counts
profile.raw_required_field_items: nonempty and unique; each must be an exact finite canonical overlay field ID or match the no-dot extension field ID grammar
profile.raw_enum_items: one through 256 nonempty unique decoded strings when enum is present
basic_string_escape_set_after_backslash: u followed by exactly four ASCII hexadecimal digits
profile.decoded_string_safety: C0 controls, DEL, unpaired UTF-16 surrogates, and the applicable decoded-string bound reject even when their source escape lexeme is syntactically recognized
profile.extension_field_id_amendment: dot is deliberately forbidden because dots are structural TOML separators and quoted or dotted extension keys are unsupported

extension_value_domains.string: 0..262144 UTF-16 code units; required strings exclude trim-empty values
extension_value_domains.array<string>: 0..256 dense items; each item 0..1024 UTF-16 code units

profile.explicit_null: present value, never absence; fails the finite field type at the exact parser-owned line
strict_toml_rejects: dotted or quoted keys and quoted, dotted-extension, nested, or array tables
floats, NaN, infinity, datetimes, exponent notation, signed integers, leading-zero integers, and hexadecimal, octal, or binary integers
single-quoted, literal, or multiline strings and unsupported escapes including escaped slash
inline tables, heterogeneous or non-string arrays, nested arrays, sparse/empty array items, and trailing array commas
NUL, tab, bare carriage return, DEL, or other disallowed controls anywhere, including comments
outside quoted strings and comments, syntax whitespace other than ASCII U+0020; this includes NBSP and FEFF
trailing assignment or table junk and unsupported bare value forms
include, import, reference, schema-ref, interpolation, or directive keys/forms
unknown root, severity, or field-rule assignments

merge.required: set union over the requireable-field domain, which excludes sensitivity
merge.severity: only the finite profile-raiseable diagnostic set may rise; fixed codes remain exact
merge.extensions: explicit finite validation-only JSON domain; never promotes or creates GKX values

sensitivity_invariants.explicit_enum_intersection_with_minimum: must remain nonempty even though sensitivity is optional

normalized_profile: exact canonical field set plus x- extensions
unique sorted field and severity coordinates
canonical type, enum, bound, severity, sensitivity, identity, and relationship floors
semantic_seal.portable_paths: runtime canonical vault-relative path grammar; absolute, drive, backslash, empty, dot-segment, colon, control, and trailing-dot/space forms reject
semantic_seal.findings: finite code-to-classification/scope/coordinate shape, exact normalized severity, and recomputed finding_id
semantic_seal.observations: complete path-wide accepted/rejected partition with contiguous ordinals, exact finding ownership, accepted-byte binding, and exact rejection correspondence
semantic_seal.rejections: canonical path/time/content bindings, sorted unique intrinsic source findings with a blocker, exact observation ordinal/profile equality, and recomputed rejection_digest
semantic_seal.results: profile-normalized digest equality, exact predicates/counts/complete observation and rejection partitions/order, and sealed nested envelopes

predicates.validate_invalid: any intrinsic or cross_record_report_only error/critical finding
predicates.strict_generation_blocked: at least one intrinsic source rejection
predicates.strict_success: zero intrinsic blockers publishes the same composite outer generation with mode strict

safe_findings.authored_relationship_field: relationships, supersedes, superseded_by, or relationships.<finite GKX relation type>, optionally followed by one canonical [declaration_index]
safe_findings.unknown_relationship_key_coordinate: relationships; attacker key never enters the finding
safe_findings.valid_proposed_declaration: retained by the canonical projection, excluded from effective candidate topology, and not an intrinsic finding
safe_findings.unmapped_canonical_diagnostic: fixed redacted intrinsic error with scope frontmatter, coordinate_basis file_observation, line null, and field null
safe_findings.result_severity: exact normalized profile severity for profile-raiseable codes, exact fixed severity for every other code, and exact unknown-field policy severity for GKX_PROFILE_UNKNOWN_FIELD

rejections.multiplicity: one zero-based source_observation_ordinal per physical observation within source_path, ordered by the frozen observation seed comparator
rejections.multiplicity_verification: the complete observations array—not the rejection subset—is contiguous 0..n-1 per source_path; rejected observations and rejections are an exact one-to-one partition and each rejection finding set equals every top-level intrinsic finding at the same path/ordinal
rejections.findings: all sorted unique safe intrinsic findings; error/critical controls rejection
rejections.finding_bounds: at most 530000 per source, derived from the sealed 262144-code-unit/4096-line parser envelope plus finite profile findings; at most 1000000 per validation result
rejections.content_binding: sealed SHA-256 and exact UTF-8 byte size when available
rejections.canonical_time_binding: authored assertion and authored validity only; null otherwise

scan_taxonomy.reason_codes: sorted unique ECMAScript UTF-16 code-unit order

ordering.string_order: ECMAScript UTF-16 code-unit lexicographic order; never locale, Unicode scalar, UTF-8 byte, filesystem, or database collation order
observation_seed_within_source_path: source_digest with null represented by empty string
source_size_bytes numeric with null represented by -1
safe_detail: empty for candidates; canonical JSON of sorted scan reason_codes for scan rejections
private deterministic candidate record key or exact-duplicate occurrence tie-break; this value never enters an envelope
findings: source_path with null represented by empty string
source_observation_ordinal numeric with null represented by -1
line numeric with null represented by 9007199254740991
field with null represented by empty string
ordering.exact_duplicate_scan_receipts: indistinguishable; swapping their private bindings cannot change sealed bytes

canonical_json_and_digests.algorithm: the frozen retrieval draft.1 stableJson algorithm: descriptor-safe plain JSON only; object keys sorted by ECMAScript UTF-16 code units; dense array order preserved; JSON.stringify-compatible finite-number rendering; no Unicode normalization; unpaired UTF-16 surrogates rejected; ingest additionally rejects unsafe integers and negative zero
canonical_json_and_digests.effective_profile_digest_preimage: complete normalized-profile envelope with no omitted fields
canonical_json_and_digests.observation_snapshot_digest_preimage: {contract_version,effective_profile_digest,sources} where sources is the exact sorted complete observations array
canonical_json_and_digests.digest_encoding: lowercase sha256:<64 hex> over UTF-8 bytes of the canonical JSON string, except overlay_sha256 which hashes raw bytes
canonical_json_and_digests.owner_manifest_digest_preimage: complete owner generation excluding owner_generation_id and owner_manifest_digest; owner_generation_id is ingest:<first 24 digest hex>
canonical_json_and_digests.active_pointer_file_digest_preimage: SHA-256 over canonical JSON bytes plus the one required terminal LF; no digest field exists inside the pointer
canonical_json_and_digests.witness_digest_preimage: complete authority witness excluding witness_digest; activating and active states therefore have distinct digests

publication_order: acquire exclusive cross-writer authority lock and seal the complete controlled namespace
derive the opaque accepted-source-only deterministic chunk plan; strict intrinsic failure stops before it
perform cache/provider work only against that plan
publish the content-addressed unactivated schema-3 inner database no-replace and reopen it
publish and verify the content-addressed rejection journal no-replace
publish and verify the content-addressed owner manifest no-replace
bind the exact activation target and public-safe inner coordinate into the authority lock
publish the first-activation migration record no-replace
publish the retained activation root no-replace; this is the irreversible no-downgrade boundary
replace the legacy pointer with the typed tombstone
publish the sole active-ingest pointer last
replace the witness with state active
verify the exact target and complete namespace, then release the writer guard
composite_publication.legacy_fallback: only before the retained activation root exists and only from an exact canonical schema-2/schema-3 legacy pointer whose database filename is derived from its projection digest
composite_publication.durable_history: the retained activation root binds the exact first owner, safe inner coordinate, migration, prior legacy digest, tombstone, pointer digest, and authority-lock digest
composite_publication.authority_witness: activating or active; both bind the retained root and exact first active-pointer file digest

safe_inner_coordinate.purpose: ordinary search and exact status applicability without owner-manifest, journal, profile, finding, rejection, or source-path materialization

composite_publication.strict_block_idempotence: an identical attempt coordinate and exact prior_active reuses the canonical status bytes without rewriting the file; status mtime and every prior active artifact byte/mtime remain unchanged
composite_publication.decision_a_storage_predicate: strict publication is allowed when ingest_intrinsic_valid is true even when corpus_valid is false; every physical accepted source/declaration remains in the inner generation and the path-free outcome is published with zero rejections
composite_publication.status_applicability: exact prior_active coordinate equals presently verified active coordinate
composite_publication.status_lifecycle: a successful pointer advance makes every older blocked status historical without rewriting it; null prior means unavailable and a verified legacy/ingest prior means stale
composite_publication.writer_serialization: legacy and Phase-3 writers use one two-way exclusive handshake through the actual pointer commit; post-migration legacy writes fail before provider/cache/new-state work
composite_publication.immutable_publication: content-addressed DB/JSON final names use no-replace publication; a crash-created exact two-link final/temp pair is owner-mode and identity sealed before recovery
composite_publication.mutable_publication: lock, status, tombstone, witness, and active pointers use bounded canonical owner-only temp+atomic replace; exact temp classes are recovered or rejected
composite_publication.state_path_safety: local-only state root, canonical parent containment, exact lowercase internal basenames, no symlink/junction/reparse/hardlink aliases, POSIX mode 0600 on every controlled JSON/DB before and after open, bounded descriptor reads with pre/open/post identity/mode/timestamp seals; Windows ACL qualification is host-specific
composite_publication.generic_release: before activation root, only exact unchanged prior plus the exact live namespace may abort; at or after root/pointer/status commit generic release refuses and retains intent
composite_publication.stale_recovery: one recoverer claims the exact stale lock by a hard link; recovery accepts only exact prior or exact bound target, completes first activation only at/after the retained root, semantically seals the complete namespace, removes canonical lock then claim
composite_publication.orphan_policy: fully sealed content-addressed pre-activation DB/journal/owner/migration artifacts may remain; they are non-authoritative until the exact pointer/root state binds them
composite_publication.ordinary_search_resolution: before first activation verify exact legacy pointer; after activation verify root/witness/migration/tombstone, public-safe pointer inner coordinate, and inner DB without loading owner manifest, validation result, rejection journal, or attempt status
composite_publication.pre_first_activation_blocked_search: the exact canonical attempt-status artifact metadata suppresses legacy auto-reindex, but ordinary search never opens, hashes, parses, or applicability-checks its owner-only bytes; it verifies and holds the unchanged legacy prior before config/provider discovery or reports safe operational unavailability
composite_publication.hidden_invalid_noninterference: after real non-strict publish and reopen, visible-only and visible-plus-intrinsic-invalid corpora produce byte-equal ordinary search envelopes and identical source-reader/query-vector/rerank call sequences; rejected bytes never cross provider boundaries

owner_storage_envelopes.rejection_journal: standalone safe-sealed normalized profile plus unique path/ordinal and rejection-digest rows; safe to classify as a crash orphan
owner_storage_envelopes.owner_reopen: binds exact journal, inner manifest, and multiplicity-sorted accepted validation observation path/digest multiset to persisted candidate source rows
owner_storage_envelopes.fixture_union_matrix: executable exact rows cover witness activating/active; lock preflight/activation/blocked; prior_active null/legacy/ingest; attempt unavailable-null/stale-legacy/stale-ingest; migration null/legacy; and all four path-free index statuses with strict and non-strict publication

cli.legacy_validate: gkx validate <dir> retains its exact Phase-0 presentation and behavior
cli.argument_mode: Phase-3 flag form and legacy positional validate are disjoint; mixing, duplicate flags, missing values, Phase-3-only flags on legacy mode, or positional index are usage errors before I/O
cli.schema_selector_parity: validate and index use the same exact gkos:frontmatter-profile/current ID or bounded local overlay path; omission selects that exact built-in ID
cli.kb_path_lexical_gate: before profile or filesystem I/O, validate both the raw spelling and its resolved absolute spelling as local-only: reject UNC, every extended/device/object-manager namespace, drive-relative and ADS spellings, reserved devices, C0/DEL, unpaired surrogates, trailing dot/space components, empty input, and a filesystem root; ordinary local absolute/relative and Windows 8.3/case spellings remain valid
cli.canonical_root_binding: after profile selection, mint one opaque directory-identity capability before scan, scan its native canonical root, and consume that same capability through state authority and the final pre-provider revalidation; replacement never creates state or reaches a provider
cli.validate_presentation: json is JSON.stringify(sealed_result,null,2)+LF; text is the exact frozen line sequence in cli-conformance-fixture.json; successful/validation output uses stdout only
cli.index_presentation: every status emits the exact path-free sealed IndexResult as JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+LF; operational_failure additionally emits one fixed safe stderr line
cli.search_routing: legacy auto-index remains pre-Phase3 only; exact attempt-status metadata suppresses auto-index without loading status bytes, and active/blocked-prior authority is verified and held before config/provider discovery; active Phase3 search resolves only the public-safe inner coordinate; authority/alias/race failures are safe exit 3
cli.fixture: cli-conformance-fixture.json is executable and binds argument modes, raw/resolved local path grammar, exact renderer/exit rows, fixed safe errors, and metadata-only search routing
